objective: Test whether a predeclared knowledge-oriented versus reasoning-oriented MMLU partition produces stronger layerwise separation than arbitrary balanced partitions of the same task suite.
sampling_rule: Select 100 test examples per subject with seed 0 and freeze document IDs before loading any model.
decision_rule: The primary result is the exact task-randomization p-value of the maximum Fisher trace ratio over all declared layers and streams. Row-wise probe screens and rejection counts are secondary. General knowledge-versus-reasoning claims require independent task and intervention replication.

apertus15-8b.runtime_condition: Use the validated Transformers Python xIELU fallback unless a new observer-parity check approves another kernel path.

analysis.computational_note: The exhaustive primary Fisher null is separated from row-wise probe refits. A selection-aware probe at the Fisher-selected site is a second analysis and is not yet implemented by the general runner.

matched_mmlu_8x8_confirmatory.role: Confirmatory within-dataset comparison with one prompt, answer space, parser, generation budget, and text-only model path.
matched_mmlu_8x8_confirmatory.claim_limit: Subject labels are comparative proxies. Several physics and medical items require both acquired facts and inference; the complete arbitrary-partition null tests only whether this chosen split is unusual among these subjects.

knowledge_tasks.rationale: Items place comparatively high demand on recalled anatomical facts.
Items place comparatively high demand on acquired astronomy knowledge, while quantitative inference remains possible.
Items require specialized clinical knowledge, with diagnostic reasoning retained as a known mixture.
Items place comparatively high demand on recalled historical facts and relations.
Items require specialized legal knowledge, with case analysis retained as a known mixture.
Items place comparatively high demand on acquired biological knowledge.
Items require specialized genetics knowledge, while inheritance calculations remain a known mixture.
Items place comparatively high demand on recalled archaeological and historical knowledge.

reasoning_tasks.rationale: Items emphasize formal symbolic manipulation and mathematical inference.
Items emphasize mathematical derivation and calculation.
Items emphasize rule-based validity and logical inference.
Items emphasize mathematical calculation and derivation.
Items emphasize discrimination of argument structure, while terminology knowledge remains a mixture.
Items comparatively emphasize applying equations and multi-step physical inference; fact recall remains a mixture.
Items comparatively emphasize qualitative physical inference; domain knowledge remains a mixture.
Items emphasize quantitative reasoning and interpretation of statistical relations.

confirmatory_inference.primary_statistic: Maximum PCA-space Fisher trace ratio over every declared layer and stream.
confirmatory_inference.primary_null: For every balanced subject partition, recompute every row's Fisher ratio and the maximum over rows.
confirmatory_inference.secondary_statistic: Task-held-out linear-probe macro-F1 at the Fisher-selected row.
confirmatory_inference.screening: Row-wise Fisher and probe p/q curves are secondary. Rejection counts must be compared with their assignment-wise null and remain appendix results.

negative_control.role: Illustrative arbitrary partition; the complete balanced-partition distribution is the inferential control.
negative_control.construction: Sort the 16 task identifiers lexicographically and assign the first eight to A.

trajectory_sensitivity.scope: Begin with OLMo 3 7B and Qwen 3.5 9B; expand only after observer parity, response-step coverage, and storage checks pass.
trajectory_sensitivity.primary_prefix: Absolute generated-token steps with at least 95 percent sample coverage in every task.
trajectory_sensitivity.selection_correction: Recompute the maximum over layer, stream, and included response step for every task partition.
trajectory_sensitivity.interpretation_limit: Absolute token positions are response trajectories, not semantic reasoning steps. Later positions are conditioned on response survival and therefore require explicit coverage reporting.

promotion_gates: All 16 tasks resolve through the identical project-local template and pass the logged-prompt audit.
Document IDs are frozen before loading a model and are identical across models.
Tracker-off/on responses, scores, token counts, and logits match on a broader calibration sample.
Fisher complement symmetry passes at every row and for the model-level maximum.
The selected-site probe is implemented with Fisher selection repeated for every task assignment before it is reported.
Correctness-conditioned and prompt-surface-adjusted sensitivity analyses are reported without changing the primary task set.
